dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001248\_46](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001248) Category 1 during the period Jan 10 2026-Jan 21 2026 in Mauritius. The center of the storm was located near latitude -35.82 longitude 62.66. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
